if_m1_eq_7: Both resolvents must survive as distinct non-tautological canonical clauses and all five retained clauses survive.

Every nonpivot root variable remains live: a variable present in a retained clause remains directly; a variable absent from all retained clauses had all three degree-3 occurrences in the three pivot clauses, and survival of both non-tautological resolvents forces compatible signs and presence in both resolvents.
Therefore n1=9. Since s1<=44 and m1=7, L1<=36, so the v0.5 selector constructively has d1<=floor(36/9)=4.
Second elimination is cap-safe because T(44)=1861/12<2401. Its clause count satisfies m2<=7-d1+floor(d1^2/4)<=7.
After the second elimination n2<=8 and every clause has width<=8, hence s2<=1+7*(1+8)=64.
Third elimination is cap-safe because T(64)=1327/4<2401.
From m2<=7, the raw clause-count bound gives m3<=max_{1<=d<=7}(7-d+floor(d^2/4))=12. With n3<=7 and width<=7, s3<=1+12*(1+7)=97.
Fourth elimination is cap-safe because T(97)=769<2401.
After the fourth elimination n4<=6. Thereafter Uraw(n)<=Uraw(6)=1053<2401 for every remaining ordinary-elimination step.

finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N49
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: Inherit N<=48. At N=49, m<=6 is invariant; low-incidence roots reroot into the previous frontier; the remaining hard region has r<=10. The r<=8 region is closed by the existing exact recurrence. The r=9 degree-3 tail stays below 2401. The r=10,m=7 branch enters m<=6. The sole new r=10,m=8,L=30 branch uses exact reachability structure: if its first mixed degree-3 step leaves seven clauses then all nine remaining variables stay live, forcing the next selected degree <=4; two additional size-and-clause-count bounds give cap-safe steps until n<=6, after which Uraw(6)=1053<2401 closes the tail. No m<=7 invariant is assumed.
